name: payments-api

dependencies.name: payment-processor
dependencies.description: Charges customers via mobile money and card at checkout, and disburses weekly merchant payouts.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends transaction and payout confirmation emails.

description: The single backend service for the platform: merchant onboarding and KYC review, checkout transaction processing, weekly payout runs, dispute mediation, platform fee configuration, and customer accounts/payment methods. Does not render any UI and does not talk to the payment processor's card/mobile-money networks directly beyond the processor's own API.
